name: ASCIITermDraw-Bench
description: ASCIITermDraw-Bench (TermDraw-Bench) evaluates whether language and vision-language models can generate and edit structured ASCII diagrams. It ships 80 tasks across 4 categories, public example tasks on Hugging Face, and a DeepEval LLM-as-a-judge scoring path. Benchmark code and tooling are licensed under Apache-2.0. Tasks, prompts, model outputs and published results are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
